root_cause: Delta identity used broad run_id, so a later batch in the same resumable run reused a now-closed path.
repair: Delta suffix now derives from the immutable selected batch composite-identity digest. run_id remains execution identity; batch digest is segment identity.
closed_delta_behavior: Closed segments are never reopened; a new batch receives a distinct deterministic delta path.
publication_order: COLD copy -> verify -> close final manifest -> registry/summary -> live reader visibility -> durable PUBLISHED -> exact HOT retirement.
